game_title: Fallback: Roll Call Enumerate – Waterfall Pool
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the forest ranger must hold off thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Then check roll_call and advance.
player_objective: Protect the elder's door from thorn goblins in Waterfall Pool: keep roll_call above zero until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 9, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
